mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park under a New Moon. If you look toward the northwest over Verona High School at 9:59 PM, you might catch the International Space Station passing by for one minute as it heads toward the northeast near Home Depot. The overnight low will drop to 54 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, a 19-year-old Madison man was arrested on September 10th following a burglary at a home on Hunter's Cove Way, where a gunshot was reported. Additionally, the City of Verona has issued various notices for the upcoming November general election.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over Main Street, and look forward to yoga and trivia events starting on Sunday.

On September 10th, Verona police officers were dispatched to Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a suspect was apprehended, treated for injuries, and faces charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a dessert.
